title: Why Early CD Players Click

scenes.text: What makes a 1990s CD player click every few seconds?
scenes.query2: CD player click every few seconds

scenes.text: A common belief is that the clicks come from a stuck disc motor.
scenes.label: Stuck motor myth

scenes.text: The clicks are actually the laser’s tracking servo correcting its position as it reads data pits.
scenes.label: Laser servo correction
scenes.query: CD laser tracking servo click sound
scenes.query2: why CD players click during playback

scenes.text: Clean the lens to reduce clicks!
scenes.label: Lens cleaning
scenes.sub: Dust on the lens triggers extra corrections.
scenes.query: how to clean CD player lens

scenes.text: Follow for the future, one byte at a time.

description: Those rhythmic clicks aren't a motor problem—they’re the laser doing its job. Discover the real reason and keep your music smooth. Follow for more tech myths debunked.
